rows.definition: The optional per-request accounting block on model.NativeInferenceReceipt, serialized as native_cache_accounting. It records the operation, total/stable/cached/restored/computed prompt-token counts, restore source and separate restore/prime durations. Validate enforces token conservation and operation constraints; absent accounting is compatible and does not supply evidence.
rows.distinction: This is caller-populated evidence about one native request, not the KV cache tensors or upstream provider prompt-cache usage. It neither owns reusable state nor proves OS page-cache warmth, expert-weight residency or exclusive request timing. Prime duration is separate from request restore duration; restored plus computed tokens must equal the total prompt.
